title: Taking a bicycle on a weekend ferry
titleZh: 週末搭渡輪攜帶自行車

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I bought two walk-on tickets for the ten o’clock ferry. We decided to bring our bicycles. Can we just show the same tickets at the ramp?
turns.zh: 我買了兩張十點渡輪的未攜車的乘客票。我們決定帶自行車。可以直接在登船坡道出示原票嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Your passenger tickets are still valid, but you need one bicycle tag for each bike. We’ve only got one tag left for that departure. The crossing takes twenty-five minutes. If you want to travel together with both bikes, the eleven o’clock ferry still has space.
turns.zh: 乘客票仍有效，但每輛自行車各要一張掛牌。那班只剩一張。航程是二十五分鐘。如果兩個人要帶兩輛車一起搭，十一點那班還有空位。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: We have to meet our friends on the other side before eleven. Is there a place to leave both bikes here?
turns.zh: 我們要在十一點前到對岸跟朋友碰面。這裡有地方可以停放兩輛車嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes. The racks beside the ticket office are free. Lock both bicycles there, then use the tickets you already have to board the ten o’clock ferry on foot.
turns.zh: 有。售票處旁的車架免費，兩輛車都鎖在那裡，再用原票步行登上十點那班渡輪。
